title: Teach the merge role to honor the in-review marker
action:
`skills/bee-herding/references/role-merge.md` must not land a worktree that route has under review. Today merge reads the same four finished conditions route does, on its own loop, with no coordination — three independent hat seats found this race.

Two edits, both following the shape the red-stop marker already has in this file:

1. **A second pre-merge marker check.** Beside the existing red-stop check (`ls .bee/tmp/bee-herding.red.<slug>` — exists → skip, say nothing), add `ls .bee/tmp/bee-herding.review.<slug>` — exists → skip this worktree, and unlike the red marker, say so ONCE through the chat pane's scrollback dedup: a worktree that looks finished but never merges is confusing silence otherwise. Add it to the quick-reference table near the end of the file that already lists the red-stop check, so both markers are visible in one place.

2. **Close the reviewer's pane too.** The cleanup step finds the worktree's runtime pane by label and closes it. A reviewed worktree may also have a pane labelled `<slug>-review`. Close that one as well, with the same 'no pane carries that label → nothing to close, not an error' posture the existing text uses. Say plainly that this is the only circumstance in which the merge role closes a review pane.

Do NOT change the four finished conditions, the proof check, the red-stop behavior, or anything else in this file. This is an additive guard.
